name: Filesystem MCP (official)
description: Wrap the official @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem. Replace the last args entry with an ABSOLUTE directory path you are willing to expose (e.g. .../warrant/examples/sandbox). Secrets: none for this server — the 'credential' is the directory list itself; do not point it at your home folder. Sync: python -m mcp_server.sync --config examples/wrap_filesystem.json. Windows uses cmd /c npx; on macOS/Linux set command to npx and drop the /c.
